title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region residency and extend audit logging for KMS access
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: tighten data residency guarantees for customer-managed keys and improve audit coverage for KMS-related operations as part of RBAC v2 hardening. This PR enforces region pinning for KMS keys referenced by model deployments and control-plane resources, adds explicit audit events for KMS usage (encrypt/decrypt/sign/rotate/grant), and introduces migration tooling and feature flags to roll the enforcement out safely.

Summary of changes: enforce policy at admission time in control plane, validate KMS key ARNs / resource IDs against resource.region, persist region-mismatch audit events, expose new metrics and tracing spans for KMS policy decisions, add e2e and unit tests, update CLI and docs for operators, and provide a migration job to identify resources that will be impacted.

What this PR contains (checklist):
- [x] Control-plane policy enforcement for KMS region pinning (RBAC v2 policy evaluator).
- [x] Audit logging: new audit event types for kms.encrypt, kms.decrypt, kms.rotate, kms.grant and a separate field audit.kms.residency_violation=true when detected.
- [x] Migration scanner: background job to list customer resources with mismatched KMS region & report remediation suggestions.
- [x] CLI flag and console indicator to opt-in/preview enforcement (feature flag: security.kms_residency_enforce).
- [x] Unit tests + e2e tests covering happy path and violation handling with mock KMS.
- [x] Docs and release notes entry.

Rollout plan: ship behind feature flag (preview) -> run migration scanner across Dedicated/Private customers with support coordination -> enable enforcement for new resources only -> staged enforcement for existing resources with grace period -> full enforcement after 30 days. We'll coordinate with SRE and Support for manual remediation runs.

Backward compatibility and migration: enforcement is opt-in until flag is flipped. The migration scanner writes a CSV report to S3 for customer ops. CLI adds `redwood infra kms-residency-scan --output s3://...` command.

Security review: design reviewed with security and compliance teams (see linked Linear tasks).

Notes for reviewers: focus on policy evaluator changes, audit schema additions, and the migration/scanner logic. The enforcement hook is intentionally small and placed in control_plane/policy/evaluator.go to minimize risk.

Related tasks: ENG-4821, ENG-4903. Linked support ticket SUP-1204.
